patch.value: GH-1185: hash-only merge receipts make discarded scalar values unreachable to the reviewing agent

On pm 2026.9.3, merge decisions retain pm_value_hash while base, ours, and theirs are null and value_availability is hash_only. pm merge report exposes the same data, so explicit acceptance requires out-of-band git archaeology. Low-cardinality hashes are cheaply enumerable while free-text hashes are irrecoverable, providing neither reliable confidentiality nor actionable review evidence.

A documented bounded policy distinguishes inline, redacted, truncated, and hash-only values; at least one supported SDK/CLI report path returns reviewable discarded evidence when policy permits; receipts never claim recoverability when only a digest exists; low-cardinality and free-text privacy negative controls pass; reconciliation and explicit acceptance remain auditable and backward compatible
pm-cli 2026.9.3; Node 26.5.0; Linux; fresh merge-driver install
Create divergent scalar values, merge to produce a field decision, then inspect the receipt and pm merge report; confirm base/ours/theirs are null and no command returns the discarded value.

A bounded privacy policy makes discarded values reviewable through a supported command or records a truthful retrievable reference, while hashes remain available for verification and oversized or sensitive values fail closed.
The only durable evidence is a digest; the agent cannot discover the discarded scalar from pm merge report and must locate historical branch state manually.
